applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan adjacent to Buildings 1, 2, 4, 7, and 8, but no clearance dimensions are provided from pad edges to building foundations or structures. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified from available plans.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls throughout site perimeter and interior
findings.comment: Existing stone retaining walls and proposed retaining walls are shown on grading and site plans, but no clearance dimensions from transformer pads to retaining wall faces are provided. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Property perimeter fences and interior fence locations
findings.comment: Fences are shown on site plan, but no dimensions indicate clearances from transformer pads to fence lines. Without documented access door orientation, cannot verify 5-foot (with operators) or 3-foot (without operators) clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Sidewalk areas adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Sidewalks are shown adjacent to transformer pads on electrical and site plans, but clearance from back of sidewalk to pad edge is not dimensioned. Minimum 2-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown without access door orientation indicated. No hot-stick clearance dimensions are provided from pad to open area or adjacent buildings/structures. Minimum 10-foot clearance to access door side cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas surrounding transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Trees are shown on landscape plan and tree list (Tree 4038H, 24-inch Live Oak marked 'Appendix F Y'), but no dimensions are provided showing horizontal distances between tree trunk centerlines and transformer pad edges. Cannot verify 10-foot lateral clearance for pad-mounted equipment or 15-foot for overhead conductors (none shown).

applicableAreas: Planted landscaping areas adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Landscape planting plan shows vegetation throughout site, including areas near transformer locations, but no clearance dimensions are provided from shrubs/vegetation to transformer pads. Minimum 10-foot clearance from access door side and 5-foot from other sides cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: No root barrier details or specifications are shown on landscape plan or detail sheets. If trees exist within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads (underground electric equipment), required 4-foot deep root barriers installed 5 feet from equipment cannot be verified as present.

applicableAreas: Fire lane circulation routes on site
findings.comment: Fire lanes are designated on fire protection plan, but no clearance dimensions are shown from transformer pad locations to fire lane boundaries. Minimum 15-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Multiple transformer pad locations (5 total)
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on electrical plan (west of Buildings 1, 2, 8; east of Building 4; south of Building 7), but no dimensions indicate clearances between pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance from each pad to other pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Water line routing throughout site near transformer pads
findings.comment: Water service lines (labeled 'W' with 2-inch HDPE material) are shown on utility plan routing near transformer pads, but no horizontal clearance dimensions are provided. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Wastewater line routing near transformer pads
findings.comment: Wastewater service lines (labeled 'WW' with 6-inch PVC at 2.0% minimum slope) are shown on utility plan near transformer locations, but no clearance dimensions are documented. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Storm drain routing in proximity to transformer pads
findings.comment: Storm drain lines (labeled 'SD') are shown on utility plan near transformer pads, particularly near Buildings 4 and 7, but no clearance dimensions are provided. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Underground utility coordination zones near transformer pads
findings.comment: Multiple underground utilities are shown routing near transformer pads (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric), but no spacing dimensions are provided between these utilities and transformer equipment. Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Overhead structures and parking garages near transformer locations
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in the electrical plan set. If overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas exist above transformer locations, their vertical clearances cannot be verified as compliant.

applicableAreas: Northeast portion of site in area of critical easements
findings.comment: Critical undepicted easements exist on the property: Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (0.31 acres, NE interior, Instrument 2010070731) and City of Austin Drainage Easement (0.130 acres, NE corner, Instrument 2011021137). These easements are not shown on site plan. If transformer pads are located within these prohibited easement areas, they cannot be placed there without AE Design written approval, which is not documented.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer easements are depicted around any of the five transformer pad locations. Easement exhibits showing boundaries and access rights for Austin Energy maintenance and operation are required but not provided.

applicableAreas: Electrical service routing from transformers to meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformer pads to electrical meters is partially shown on electrical plan, but the complete routing path to final meter locations is not fully traced or documented. Cannot verify that 100% of electrical service routing remains on private property throughout its entire length.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pad installations
findings.comment: No dimensions (width x length) are provided for any of the five transformer pads shown on the electrical plan. No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for the specified service type are included in the submittal. Pad dimensions must match AE Design-approved standards.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads west of Building 1, east of Building 4, and south of Building 7
findings.comment: Vision analysis indicates transformer pads located west of Building 1, east of Building 4, and south of Building 7 are positioned within approximately 4 feet of adjacent drive aisle curb lines. No bollards are shown on electrical plan. Required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details are not depicted.
